headline: A new chance for Indianapolis
what_happened: The Colts moved the ball forward on a short run to earn a first down, which is a fresh set of four tries to keep moving toward a score.
who: T.Warren carried the ball while G.Karlaftis tried to stop him.
why_it_matters: This is tough for our Chiefs since the Colts kept their drive alive, slightly increasing their odds of winning by two percentage points.
pop_culture: Taylor Swift is watching from the suite, and her vintage Chiefs tank top sold out online after the game.
